summary: Small-system heavy-ion signatures and validation-focused physics AI dominate this run: CMS reports Lambda/K0S baryon enhancement in oxygen-oxygen collisions; theory papers target jet-wake anisotropy and CGC transform bottlenecks; transferable AI/ML work focuses on simulation-to-data adaptation, calorimeter fast simulation, robust validation standards, and interpretable transport emulation.
strongest_paper: CMS observation of enhanced Lambda/K0S baryon production in oxygen-oxygen collisions, with the CGC Filon-quadrature paper close behind as the strongest technical infrastructure contribution.

papers.title: Observation of enhanced baryon production using strange hadrons in oxygen-oxygen collisions
papers.abstract: CMS measures K0S and Lambda spectra in O-O and pp collisions at 5.36 TeV and observes a pronounced Lambda-to-K0S enhancement in O-O relative to pp.

papers.title: The elliptic wind on jet wakes in high-energy heavy-ion collisions
papers.authors: Kai-Yi Wu, Zhong Yang, Xin-Nian Wang
papers.abstract: The paper studies elliptic-flow distortions of jet-induced wakes and proposes gamma-jet correlation observables sensitive to wake broadening and shear viscosity.

papers.title: Fourier Transforms of Color Glass Condensate Multi-Wilson-Line Correlators via Filon Quadrature
papers.authors: Haowu Duan, Si-Wei Dai, Cong Yi, Wenbin Zhao
papers.abstract: A Filon-quadrature and GPU approach accelerates oscillatory Hankel transforms of CGC multi-Wilson-line correlators and validates the method on DIS and analytic tests.

papers.title: Upsilon(nS) Production within Jets at the LHC
papers.authors: Taewook Ha, Hee Sok Chung, Daekyoung Kang, Yunlu Wang, Haixiang Zhu
papers.abstract: An NLO fragmenting-jet-function study predicts bottomonium-in-jet distributions and argues they are less LDME-sensitive than charmonium-in-jet observables.

papers.title: Symbolic Regression for Interpretable Emulation of Proton Collective Flow in Intermediate-Energy Heavy-Ion Collisions
papers.authors: Nicholas Cox, Xavier Grundler, Bao-An Li
papers.abstract: Symbolic-regression emulators reproduce IBUU proton flow observables with DNN-like accuracy while providing analytic expressions and fast evaluation.

papers.title: Transferable Fast Calorimeter Shower Generation via Multi-Geometry Pre-training
papers.authors: Thorsten Buss, Henry Day-Hall, Frank Gaede, Gregor Kasieczka, Katja Kruger, Peter McKeown, Lorenzo Valente
papers.abstract: Multi-geometry pretraining improves point-cloud calorimeter shower generation on unseen detector layouts with limited target showers.

papers.title: Safe Domain Adaptation for Physics: Overcoming Nuisances, Label Shifts, and Simulation Priors
papers.abstract: The paper identifies simulation-prior bias in adversarial domain adaptation and proposes reweighted adaptive domain adaptation with label-free model selection.

papers.title: Exploring the limits of high-energy proton-pion separation in granular calorimeters
papers.authors: Andrea De Vita, Abhishek, Tommaso Dorigo, Pietro Vischia
papers.abstract: Deep Sets improves isolated proton-pion separation in highly granular Geant4 calorimeters relative to BDT shower-observable baselines.

papers.title: VERaiPHY -- Validation & Evaluation for Robust AI in PHYsics
papers.authors: Gaia Grosso, Ramon Winterhalder, Lydia Brenner, Louis Lyons, Tilman Plehn
papers.abstract: A PHYSTAT-linked foundation article sets statistical and probabilistic standards for validating robust AI in fundamental physics.

papers.title: FAST-HEP: Compiling Declarative Analysis Workflows for High-Energy Physics and Beyond
papers.abstract: FAST-HEP compiles declarative analysis workflows into backend-independent plans with validation, provenance, and replaceable runtime capabilities.

papers.title: Exact time-correlated coincidence modeling with reset boundaries
papers.abstract: A statistical framework derives exact ordered coincidence rates under reset boundaries and dead time, validated by toy Monte Carlo.
